description: Send a Signal to a running Temporal workflow as a Dagster asset. For long-lived workflows that need Dagster-driven state pushes (flush, add, kick, shutdown).

workflow_id.description: Target workflow ID. Signals are addressed by workflow_id, not by run — if there's a currently running run of this id, it receives the signal.
workflow_id.label: Workflow ID

signal_name.description: Signal handler name defined on the workflow.
signal_name.label: Signal Name

signal_args.description: Positional args for the signal. If both `signal_args` and `signal_arg` are set, `signal_arg` is appended.
signal_args.label: Signal Args

signal_arg.description: Convenience: single arg (dict/str/int) when the signal handler takes exactly one input.
signal_arg.label: Signal Arg

api_key_env_var.description: Temporal Cloud API key env var.
api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var

tls_server_root_ca_env_var.label: Tls Server Root Ca Env Var
